title: guest_invite_create
description: A member device whose rule setup_devices contains the kind guest asks for a guest invitation: a one-time guest PIN (5 minutes) shown as QR code; the guest scans it with its own phone. The member chooses within the same frame as when setting up a device: a guest profile of setup_grant (purpose invite; default: the default guest profile when offered, else the first), the end of the access (at most 90 days) and remote access (only with remote_choice). Everything else (areas: those of the profile, later changes) stays with the admin. A new invitation replaces its own open one (guest_invite_ended {replaced}). Answer: guest_invite or guest_invite_error.

expires_at.description: End of the guest access (in the future, at most guest_access.max_hours ahead). Missing = guest_access.default_hours after pairing.

remote.description: Remote access of the guest, only with remote_choice of the profile. Missing = profile value.

access_windows.description: Optional, only with access_hours_choice of the chosen profile in setup_grant (else guest_invite_error access_hours_not_allowed): access hours of the guest, a device adjustment of access_hours when it pairs. Missing = profile value.
